newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids up shaprly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring bids up shaprly.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat bids were up sharply on Friday but the rise failed to shake loose much grain, several cash merchants said.

"The basis is coming up a bit here," one Montana source said. "The board was up about seven and we're up another six on the basis. It hasn't really done much of anything. The farmer is still not selling."
Concerns persisted that dry weather in northwest North Dakota and eastern Montana would reduce yields.
"We've still got the dry weather and everyone is worried about that," one dealer said.
"They've got a chance for rain this weekend so we'll just keep our fingers crossed," he added.
White wheat bids were steady on Friday after a sharp break on Thursday tied to weak demand and increased farmer selling interest.
